DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteoarthritis of the hips and knees with potential secondary inflammatory arthritis in the left great toe.

The X-ray confirms osteoarthritis in your hips and knees and rules out cellulitis, which typically presents with acute skin redness and warmth rather than chronic joint pain. While the imaging did not show acute issues in the big toe, your history of pain there combined with gout-like triggers suggests you may also have intermittent gout or an overuse injury, but your primary diagnosis is osteoarthritis.
